instructions:
1. Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor.
2. Place your hands behind your head, elbows wide.
3. Lift your chest and twist your torso, bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee.
4. Lower under control back to the floor.
5. Twist to the other side.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
2. Move slowly and avoid pulling on your neck.
3. Exhale as you twist, inhale as you lower.
4. Drive the rotation from your core, not your arms.

instructions:
1. Stand on the middle of the band with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Hold a handle in each hand, arms extended down, palms facing forward.
3. Keep your elbows close to your torso and curl the right handle toward your shoulder.
4. Lower it under control to the start.
5. Curl the left handle the same way, alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your wrists straight throughout.
2. Move slowly so the band controls you, not momentum.
3. The band tension peaks at the top, so squeeze hard there.
4. Keep your back straight and shoulders down.

instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with feet flat on the floor.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing each other.
3. Keep your elbows close to your torso and curl the right dumbbell toward your shoulder.
4. Squeeze at the top, then lower under control.
5. Curl the left dumbbell the same way, alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your wrists neutral and straight.
2. Control the lowering phase, no swinging.
3. Keep your torso upright and still.
4. Focus on the squeeze at the top.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing each other.
3. Keep your elbows close to your torso and curl the right dumbbell toward your shoulder.
4. Squeeze at the top, then lower under control.
5. Curl the left dumbbell the same way, alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your wrists neutral and straight.
2. Brace your core to stop your torso swaying.
3. Control the lowering phase, no momentum.
4. Keep your back straight and shoulders back.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with legs extended about 45 degrees off the floor and arms reaching overhead.
2. Lift your shoulders off the mat and brace your core.
3. Pull your right knee toward your chest while swinging both arms in an arc to your sides.
4. Straighten the leg and lower your arms and shoulders to the start.
5. Repeat with the left leg, alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
2. Move slowly and with control, no momentum.
3. Exhale as you crunch the knee in, inhale as you extend.
4. Keep the extended leg from dropping too low if your back arches.
